scene: Two relatives talk after weeks of sharing care for an older family member. One feels guilty about needing a day away, while the other is exhausted and afraid that any discussion of limits will sound selfish.

role_a.name: Arden
role_a.profile: Enjoy testing ideas and making a friendly challenge out of difficult choices. Keep the shared outcome more important than proving that you were right.

role_b.name: Jordan
role_b.profile: Keep the discussion moving toward an actionable choice. Be direct about tradeoffs, but do not force a decision before hearing material concerns.

route_note: Two role-conditioned streams generate content and timing through shared acoustic feedback.
